request.prompt: A handmade white ceramic cup with a thin cobalt rim on a pale oak cafe table. Soft morning window light, natural photographic texture, shallow depth of field. Vertical composition, cup centered in the lower half with clear caption space above. No lettering, no hands, no extra cups.

detailed_description:
The opening frame matches the supplied image. Photorealistic morning café. [Shot 1] Close-up of the cup. A thin ribbon of steam curls upward, initially to the left, then straightens. A slow ten-centimeter push-in brings the cobalt rim into sharp detail while the distant window stays softly blurred. The cup remains still.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet café room tone, no dialogue.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic, shallow depth of field. [Shot 1] Medium view from the side. In the first three seconds an adult hand enters from screen right, grips the handle, and gently rotates the cup a quarter-turn toward the window. The camera tracks ten centimeters with the hand. During the final two seconds the hand releases and leaves to the right; camera settles as steam rises.
